name: zillow-mcp
description: Zillow real-estate access for Claude — search listings, fetch property details, Zestimate history, saved searches & homes, market reports

tools.name: zillow_search_properties
tools.description: Search Zillow listings by location and optional filters (status, price, beds/baths, home type)

tools.name: zillow_sweep_area
tools.description: Exhaustively enumerate Zillow listings in an area by recursive map tiling and report completeness; returns the listings inline, or writes them to an optional JSON output_path.

tools.name: zillow_get_property
tools.description: Fetch a property's details (price, Zestimate, beds/baths, size, schools; price history on request) by zpid or homedetails URL

tools.name: zillow_get_by_address
tools.description: Resolve a free-text address to its Zillow zpid and homedetails URL

tools.name: zillow_resolve_addresses
tools.description: Resolve a batch of addresses to Zillow zpids and homedetails URLs in one call

tools.name: zillow_bulk_get
tools.description: Fetch many Zillow property records in one call by zpid or URL, one row per input

tools.name: zillow_compare_properties
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-25 properties with a pivoted summary table

tools.name: zillow_get_property_photos
tools.description: The full photo gallery for a property by zpid or URL

tools.name: zillow_get_zestimate_history
tools.description: Historical Zestimate time series for a property by zpid or URL

tools.name: zillow_get_price_history
tools.description: Listing-price events (listed, price changes, pending, sold) for a property by zpid or URL

tools.name: zillow_get_tax_history
tools.description: Year-by-year property-tax and assessed-value record for a property by zpid or URL

tools.name: zillow_get_saved_searches
tools.description: The signed-in user's saved searches with new-listing counts

tools.name: zillow_get_saved_homes
tools.description: The signed-in user's saved (favorited) homes

tools.name: zillow_get_market_report
tools.description: Market report for a region — median sale/list prices, days on market, inventory, new listings, ZHVI and its year-over-year change

tools.name: zillow_calculate_mortgage
tools.description: Local PITI mortgage-payment calculator — no network

tools.name: zillow_calculate_affordability
tools.description: Local 28/36 debt-to-income affordability calculator: max home price from income, debts, down payment and rate — no network

tools.name: zillow_estimate_rent_vs_buy
tools.description: Local projection of the cumulative cost of buying versus renting over N years — no network

tools.name: zillow_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the browser bridge with a no-op zillow.com round-trip (robots.txt)

tools.name: zillow_register_session
tools.description: Register a named account label in the local session registry (label only — calls always use the signed-in browser tab)

tools.name: zillow_set_active_session
tools.description: Mark a registered session label as active (label only — does not switch accounts)

tools.name: zillow_get_session_context
tools.description: Show the registered sessions and which one is active
